mapper.select: INSERT INTO projects (tenant_id, name, description) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{name}, #{description}) RETURNING id::text, name, description, version, created_at, updated_at
SELECT id::text, name, description, version, created_at, updated_at FROM projects WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE projects SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, version = version + 1, updated_at = date_trunc('milliseconds', clock_timestamp()) WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} RETURNING id::text, name, description, version, created_at, updated_at
